title: Pilk asks for help

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Oh, great that you found the time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, great that you found the time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm very busy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm very busy.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: It's a delicate topic, and I need to be sure you understand that. Do you work with LifeCorp in any way?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a delicate topic, and I need to be sure you understand that. Do you work with LifeCorp in any way?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure. Big fan!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Big fan!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why should I tell you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why should I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Then I am sorry I wasted your time. Have a good day!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I am sorry I wasted your time. Have a good day!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, bye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, bye.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, I was messing around. I don't work with the Corp.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, I was messing around. I don't work with the Corp.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait, I was messing around. I don't work with the Corp.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait, I was messing around. I don't work with the Corp.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: That was what my sources told me. Good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was what my sources told me. Good.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I need someone who knows a lot of people and who has a certain ... resilience, if approached by the corps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need someone who knows a lot of people and who has a certain ... resilience, if approached by the corps.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like we need to talk compensation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like we need to talk compensation.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like we need to talk compensation.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like we need to talk compensation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would I risk anything for, let's be honest, a pretty terrible landlord?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would I risk anything for, let's be honest, a pretty terrible landlord?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would I risk anything for, let's be honest, a pretty terrible landlord?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would I risk anything for, let's be honest, a pretty terrible landlord?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I can offer you some cash incentive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can offer you some cash incentive.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the deal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the deal?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I have some ... wealthy ... tenants.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have some ... wealthy ... tenants.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Very wealthy. And not all of their wealth came from legal endeavors.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very wealthy. And not all of their wealth came from legal endeavors.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds shady.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds shady.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And that's why you don't want to involve the corps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And that's why you don't want to involve the corps.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And that's why you don't want to involve the corps.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And that's why you don't want to involve the corps.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: A tenant of mine whose name you will never learn lost something of great personal value.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A tenant of mine whose name you will never learn lost something of great personal value.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean it was stolen?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean it was stolen?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: One of my cleaners allegedly took it. He vanished, and yesterday his body was found in the docks. Not a great scene.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One of my cleaners allegedly took it. He vanished, and yesterday his body was found in the docks. Not a great scene.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am neither the lost property office nor a fence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am neither the lost property office nor a fence.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I am neither the lost property office nor a fence.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I am neither the lost property office nor a fence.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So this item is worth killing for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So this item is worth killing for?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So this item is worth killing for?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So this item is worth killing for?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Absolutely. It was a watch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Absolutely. It was a watch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A watch? Are you kidding me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A watch? Are you kidding me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A watch? Are you kidding me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A watch? Are you kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A watch? That's not more than a few Lims!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A watch? That's not more than a few Lims!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A watch? That's not more than a few Lims!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A watch? That's not more than a few Lims!

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: This watch is special. A family heirloom. A mechanical watch, thousands of years old.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This watch is special. A family heirloom. A mechanical watch, thousands of years old.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: A Long & Sons One Tourbillon Perpetual from before the first Erasera. Easily worth a million Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A Long & Sons One Tourbillon Perpetual from before the first Erasera. Easily worth a million Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tourbillon?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tourbillon?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Perpetual?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perpetual?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A million ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A million ...

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Probably more. As I said...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably more. As I said...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Money is not an issue.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Money is not an issue.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What more can you tell me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What more can you tell me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What more can you tell me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What more can you tell me?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: The tenant wants the watch back. I would rather not lose him. And I would rather not end this search like my cleaner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The tenant wants the watch back. I would rather not lose him. And I would rather not end this search like my cleaner.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: You are building a reputation for... getting things done. So any help you can give me will be very appreciated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are building a reputation for... getting things done. So any help you can give me will be very appreciated.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Here's 200 Lims as a down payment for your efforts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here's 200 Lims as a down payment for your efforts.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Appreciated how much?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Appreciated how much?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: I'm not a watchmaker. If you find one in Nivalis, they could probably tell you more about the technical aspects.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not a watchmaker. If you find one in Nivalis, they could probably tell you more about the technical aspects.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing to do with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing to do with me.
